+"""Standalone, strict variant of ``_pytest.compat.iscoroutinefunction``.
+
+This module intentionally depends only on the standard library ``inspect``
+module so it can be imported without pulling in pytest or asyncio (and the
+``logging`` initialization that importing asyncio triggers).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import inspect
+
+
+__all__ = ["is_strict_coroutine_function"]
+
+
+def is_strict_coroutine_function(func: object) -> bool:
+    """Return True if func is a coroutine function (a function defined with async
+    def syntax, and doesn't contain yield), or a function carrying the legacy
+    ``@asyncio.coroutine`` marker.
+
+    Unlike ``_pytest.compat.iscoroutinefunction``, the legacy ``_is_coroutine``
+    marker is only accepted when it is literally ``True``; any other value,
+    truthy or not, is rejected, and the result is always a ``bool``.
+    """
+    return inspect.iscoroutinefunction(func) or (
+        getattr(func, "_is_coroutine", False) is True
+    )
diff --git a/testing/test_standalone_strict_coroutine_marker.py b/testing/test_standalone_strict_coroutine_marker.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..397e05ba1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_standalone_strict_coroutine_marker.py
@@ -0,0 +1,107 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
+from collections.abc import Iterator
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from types import ModuleType
+
+import pytest
+
+
+MODULE_PATH = (
+    Path(__file__).parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_strict_coroutine_marker.py"
+)
+
+
+def _load_module() -> ModuleType:
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_strict_coroutine_marker", MODULE_PATH
+    )
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+is_strict_coroutine_function = _load_module().is_strict_coroutine_function
+
+
+def test_async_def_is_coroutine_function() -> None:
+    async def coro() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    assert is_strict_coroutine_function(coro) is True
+
+
+def test_plain_and_generator_functions_are_not() -> None:
+    def func() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    def gen() -> Iterator[None]:
+        yield
+
+    async def agen() -> AsyncIterator[None]:
+        yield
+
+    assert is_strict_coroutine_function(func) is False
+    assert is_strict_coroutine_function(gen) is False
+    assert is_strict_coroutine_function(agen) is False
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("obj", [None, 0, "", [], {}, object()])
+def test_empty_and_non_callable_inputs(obj: object) -> None:
+    assert is_strict_coroutine_function(obj) is False
+
+
+def test_legacy_marker_literal_true_is_accepted() -> None:
+    def func() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    func._is_coroutine = True  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    assert is_strict_coroutine_function(func) is True
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("marker", [object(), 1, "yes", [1], False, None, 0])
+def test_legacy_marker_other_values_are_rejected(marker: object) -> None:
+    def func() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    func._is_coroutine = marker  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    assert is_strict_coroutine_function(func) is False
+
+
+def test_attribute_errors_other_than_attributeerror_propagate() -> None:
+    class Boom:
+        @property
+        def _is_coroutine(self) -> bool:
+            raise RuntimeError("boom")
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="boom"):
+        is_strict_coroutine_function(Boom())
+
+
+def test_missing_attribute_via_attributeerror_is_false() -> None:
+    class Missing:
+        @property
+        def _is_coroutine(self) -> bool:
+            raise AttributeError("nope")
+
+    assert is_strict_coroutine_function(Missing()) is False
+
+
+def test_import_has_no_pytest_or_asyncio_side_effects() -> None:
+    code = (
+        "import importlib.util, sys\n"
+        f"spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', {str(MODULE_PATH)!r})\n"
+        "module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n"
+        "spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n"
+        "bad = [n for n in ('asyncio', 'pytest', '_pytest') if n in sys.modules]\n"
+        "assert not bad, bad\n"
+    )
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, "-c", code], capture_output=True, text=True, check=False
+    )
+    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
notes:
Copied the iscoroutinefunction control flow into a stdlib-only module (inspect.iscoroutinefunction short-circuit first, then getattr marker) with the single change that the _is_coroutine marker must be identical to True; tests load the module by file path and cover async/sync/generator inputs, falsy inputs, marker values, getattr error propagation, and import isolation from pytest/asyncio.
